meta.name: ley-ar
meta.description: Search Argentine legal databases (SAIJ, JUBA, CSJN, JUSCABA) for jurisprudence, legislation, case summaries, and doctrine using the `ley` CLI. Use when the user asks about Argentine law, court decisions, legal precedents, fallos, jurisprudencia, legislación, or mentions SAIJ, JUBA, CSJN, JUSCABA. Supports parallel search across databases, JSON/table/text output, and filtering by jurisdiction. Built from reverse-engineered MCP servers (hernan-cc) — direct HTTP calls, no MCP layer needed.
